s: Mi sheeno yakol lehishshamer mehapiach ubo g' seipim: mi shemmityalled lo ruach bebitno umotzi ruchot babboqer ubari lo sheeno yakol laamod al atzmo millehapiach ad sheyyigmor kol tepillat y"ch — mutab sheyyaabor zeman hattepilla mimmah sheyyitpallel belo gup naqi, shehattepilla yesh lah tashlumin, sheim neenas velo hitpallel shacharit — mitpallel mincha shettayim, vezeh gam ken anus hu shei epshar lo lehitpallel y"ch belo gup naqi, sheggenay gadol hu lehapiach kesheomed lipne hammelek umedabber immo ukeday bizzayon vaqatzep, shehare hitzriku leharchiq d' ammot keshemmebaqqesh lehapiach battepilla vei epshar lo laamod al atzmo kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"g:

Vekevan (a) sheeno mitpallel tepillat y"ch shel shacharit — lo yomar gam ken pesuqe dezimra, ella im ken yomar belo birkoteha keqore battora, shehem nitqenu bibraka kede lesadder shebachayv shel haqqadosh baruk hu qodem hattepilla, kemo shennitbaer besiman n"a n"b:

Abal (b) qeriat shema ubirkoteha tzarik lomar bizmannan apillu belo gup naqi, sheeno niqra medabber im hammelek ella kesheomed lepanayv bitpillat y"ch kemo shennitbaer besiman a"d. Veap sheyyiqra qeriat shema belo tepillin shehattepillin tzerikin gup naqi — lo yamtin veyaabor zeman qeriat shema kede liqrotah bitpillin, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"v. Veim yeraeh lo sheyyukal laamod al atzmo bishat qeriat shema — yaniach tepillin ben "ahaba" liqriat shema vibarek alehen veachar kak yachletzem miyyad. Abal hattallit yakol lilbosh ulebarek qodem sheyyatchil habberakot, sheen tzarik gup naqi latztzitzit:
